types.label: Veto browser notices
types.description: Timer started, 30 s left and running, as browser notifications while the console is open. The veto banner itself stays.

types.label: Veto alarm in the console
types.description: The alarm that rings in an open console while a call counts down. Its tone and timing stay in Settings → Plugins → Approvals banner.

types.label: Approval waiting (from the console)
types.description: The console reads axHub's approvals with its own owner sign-in and raises one alert per call waiting for you, so the bell, web push and ntfy carry it without the AmberX web app. Clears when the call is decided or expires. Off on AmberX by default: its watch already rings for approvals straight from axHub.

types.label: Veto call counting down (from the console)
types.description: A held call that runs by itself unless you stop it, raised by the console from axHub's feed and pushed through web push and ntfy. Off on AmberX by default: its veto alarm already rings straight from axHub.
